model: ABB ACH550 (ABB DRV LIM profile, 5305 = 0) via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: ABB ACH550 HVAC drives on embedded fieldbus (Modbus RTU) with parameter 5305 = 0 (ABB DRV LIM profile), read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the ABB ACH550 using the ABB DRV LIM control profile: 583 objects (546 AI, 4 AO, 33 BI), 112 polled by default. The control word bits (OFF1, OFF2, OFF3, START, RESET), status word bits (RDY_RUN, TRIPPED, ALARM, REMOTE), actual signals and the parameter list are mapped; four Analog Outputs write the control words and references. It is the same map as the DRV FULL profile without the REMOTE_CMD bit, so every instance after BI 7 is one lower.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile ABB_Drive_DRV_LIM_5305_is_0_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the ACH550 user's manual (3AUA0000081823), embedded fieldbus section (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/3AUA0000081823_REVC.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 112 of the 583 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (EXT2; INTEGRATION TIME; DERIVATION TIME...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Set the drive for fieldbus control and 5305 = 0. Write the ABB DRV control word (AO 36, register 40001) for start/stop and Reference 1 (AO 37) for speed; read RDY_REF, TRIPPED, ALARM and the actual values.
integration.enable: Set the drive's EXT1 command and reference sources to COMM and parameter 5305 = 0; start/stop then comes from the control word at register 40001.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: ACH550 parameter 5305 (EFB CTRL PROFILE) selects the control profile: 0 = ABB DRV LIM, 1 = DCU PROFILE, 2 = ABB DRV FULL. Load the BASgatewayLX profile that matches it.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
